AnalysisSurface.Policy: Packages/Drivers plus Packages/Drivers/Display* graphics INF observed

AnalysisSemantics.AsPublished: Microsoft TargetOSVersion / Models selection semantics applied to the unmodified INF.
AnalysisSemantics.ServerProjection: Analytical projection that changes explicit ProductType=1 decorations to ProductType=3 without modifying the source INF.
AnalysisSemantics.CompatibilityBoundary: Static candidate analysis only. Runtime compatibility, signature acceptance, binary ABI behavior, and actual device installation are not proven.
AnalysisSemantics.RepositoryPortability: Machine-local absolute paths are removed from canonical records; run-specific extractor paths/logs remain Evidence-only.
AnalysisSemantics.VendorSelectorBoundary: Chipset-specific DevID.xml/MSI/SETxxx selector logic is not imported into Graphics. Vendor embedded conditions remain a separate evidence layer.

AnalysisPolicy.CanonicalTruth: Observed INF/manifest facts are preserved separately from derived Windows Server analysis.
AnalysisPolicy.ServerProjection: ProductType=1 to ProductType=3 is simulated only; no INF file is modified.
